deployments_detail.use: Live Translation, a network-native agentic AI service that translates live voice calls in near real time across 50+ languages by dialing a code, with no app or special device required. Launched as a beta built directly into the 5G core network.

AI-native RAN Scheduler with Link Adaptation, a neural network running on Ericsson hardware to predict rapidly changing radio conditions and optimize scheduling on the live 5G-Advanced network (claimed world first). [Ericsson]
deployments_detail.value: ~10% higher spectral efficiency, up to 15% higher downlink throughput

deployments_detail.use: Dynamic CX, an AI-powered self-organizing-network capability that predicts and prevents congestion, adapting the network in near real time as crowds and demand shift at large live events (e.g. 2026 FIFA World Cup).

AI-RAN Innovation Center and pilots using NVIDIA AI Aerial / accelerated compute (ARC-Pro, Blackwell) to embed AI into the radio access network; T-Mobile was first US carrier to pilot NVIDIA AI-RAN infrastructure (with Nokia anyRAN), moving toward commercial field tests. [NVIDIA (AI Aerial), Nokia]
AI-RAN integration into 5G-Advanced network for handling customer calls
5G Advanced - AI and ML for network performance optimization
"IntentCX" intent-driven AI customer-experience platform (OpenAI; real-time sentiment/problem-prevention)

IntentCX, an intent-driven AI-decisioning platform for customer care that ingests T-Life app and interaction data to autonomously understand and act on customer needs, augmenting service reps. Reported live and 'paying dividends' by Oct 2025. [OpenAI]

PromoGenius, a generative-AI retail/care assistant agent built on Microsoft Copilot Studio, embedded in the app so reps can instantly pull device specs and comparisons from 20+ manufacturer sites during customer conversations. [Microsoft Copilot Studio]

Customer care conversational AI using Google Cloud Contact Center AI and Dialogflow to power AI-driven voice/chat interactions, plus BigQuery ML to predict usage trends and personalize customer experiences. [Google Cloud (Dialogflow, Contact Center AI, BigQuery ML)]
IntentCX - intent-driven AI platform for customer experience and decision-making [OpenAI]
PromoGenius app - AI-powered customer service representative tool [Microsoft Power Apps]
Broad Microsoft 365 Copilot rollout to employees as the company's go-to workplace AI assistant for productivity across the workforce. [Microsoft 365 Copilot]
deployments_detail.value: ~20,000 employees using it; 60% say Copilot improves work

deployments_detail.use: Salesforce-built sales application using Einstein AI, agents, and workflows to streamline the sales process and track data across channels; long-standing use of Einstein AI to increase sales productivity. [Salesforce Einstein]

Generative-AI RAN optimization chatbot built on Amazon Bedrock hosting Anthropic's Claude foundation models, letting engineers query and optimize radio access network performance conversationally. [AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude]
Scam Shield, network-level AI/ML that automatically identifies and blocks scam and spam calls, flags suspected scam callers (Scam ID) and blocks malicious websites for all customers at no extra cost.
